name: inputs-calcs-outputs-design
title_zh: 三张表分家的 Excel 模型设计稿
tagline_zh: 模型越改越乱、公式里藏着硬编码数字、别人接手看不懂？它先逼你把输入、计算、输出拆成三张表。
tagline_en: Tired of hardcoded numbers buried in formulas and models nobody else can read? It splits Inputs, Calcs, and.
desc_en: Enforces the three-tab separation principle for any Excel model, producing a full design for a dedicated Inputs tab, one or more Calculations tabs, and a clean Outputs tab with a conventions checklist.
why_zh: 先定边界再写公式：所有假设只住在 Inputs，计算层不许出现魔法数字，输出层只做呈现。
why_en: Boundaries first, formulas second: assumptions live only in Inputs, no magic numbers in Calcs, Outputs only present. It ships.
limit_zh: 只出设计稿和约定清单，不生成 .xlsx 文件、不写具体公式；已有模型它只给重构建议，不会自动改你的表。
limit_en: Design doc and conventions checklist only: no .xlsx file, no actual formulas. For existing models it suggests refactors but never edits your sheets.
title_en: Excel model design that splits Inputs, Calcs, and Outputs.
